dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit soft-edged perimeters with a visible pixel gradient transitioning from the dark background pelt (exterior) to the high-intensity ring (interior). The most distinct structures are found on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, isolated high-intensity speckles distributed primarily along the mid-anterior dorsal line, with higher clustering observed near the cervical region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented roughly parallel to the spinal column.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant focal lesion with exposed red tissue (likely a fresh wound) located on the dorsal-lateral surface of the posterior flipper/tail region.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-intensity specular reflection point located in the center of the ocular region.
